tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The CA (firm) should have minimum 3 years of experience (with valid registration and empanelment certification) in conducting concurrent audit services, internal audit services with a State Government, PSUs or Semi Government or Private Sectors

Qualifications and Competence of the key professional staff for the assignment. The firm / agency should have multi-disciplinary engineering human resource in the field of civil /mechanical / electrical and environment
Experience in providing TPIA & auditing services in Karnataka
The firm/ agency must have registered under Companies Registration Act or Societies Act

The Agency should have a minimum Total Financial Turnover 5 Crores in the last five years (i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26) Consolidated financial turnover certificate certified by Chartered Accountant shall be submitted, along with compulsory UDIN Id No

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The firm/ agency/ institution should have a minimum of 5 years of experience of undertaking inspection of project works relating to water supply and/ or civil infrastructure and should have monitored at least two projects For TPIA firm, work done certificates issued by the employer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent Cadre person shall be submitted mandatorily
Adequacy of the Proposed Work plan and Methodology in responding to the TOR.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Experience in providing TPIA & auditing services in Karnataka

Qualifications and Competence of the key professional staff for the assignment. The firm / agency should have multi-disciplinary engineering human resource in the field of civil /mechanical / electrical and environment
The Agency should have a minimum Total Financial Turnover 5 Crores in the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26
The firm/ agency must have registered under Companies Registration Act or Societies Act

The firm/ agency/ institution should have a minimum of 5 years of experience of undertaking inspection of project works relating to water supply and/ or civil infrastructure and should have monitored at least two projects
